meta.name: coverage-report
meta.description: Generate a .NET code coverage report scoped to files changed in the current branch. Runs tests with coverage collection and produces filtered HTML reports.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成仅含变更代码的 .NET 覆盖率报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在 .NET 项目中追踪代码变更的测试覆盖情况
copy.tagline_en: Generate .NET coverage report only for changed files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to track test coverage for changed code in .NET projects

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会分析当前 Git 分支与基分支（如 main）相比有变化的 .cs 源文件，然后运行相关测试并收集代码覆盖率，最终生成一个只针对这些变更文件的 HTML 覆盖率报告，并在终端显示摘要。
howto.when: 当你要求为当前分支的代码变更生成覆盖率报告时触发。例如，你说“生成覆盖率报告”或“对比主分支看看我改的代码测试覆盖率”。

say.text: 为当前分支生成代码覆盖率报告
say.note: Claude 会自动检测变更并生成报告

say.text: 帮我看看这次改动的测试覆盖率
say.note: 只针对你修改过的文件生成报告

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes .cs source files changed in the current Git branch compared to a base branch (e.g., main), runs relevant tests with code coverage collection, and generates an HTML coverage report filtered to only those changed files, also printing a text summary.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a code coverage report scoped to changes in the current branch. For example, 'Generate a coverage report' or 'Show test coverage for my changes.'

say_en.text: Generate a code coverage report for the current branch
say_en.note: Claude will detect changes and produce the report

say_en.text: Check test coverage for my recent changes
say_en.note: Report will only include files you modified
